policy_notes: REA is the preferred external reverse-engineering tool when installed and healthy.
The skill owns interpretation, authorization boundary, evidence classification and reconstruction guidance; REA remains a replaceable tool.
Installing REA does not install Ghidra, IDA, Hopper, JADX, Binwalk, Unblob or other external engines automatically.
Do not analyze third-party targets without authorization. Do not use the tool for persistence, credential theft, evasion or destructive testing.
